analysis:
Both changed files are documentation only. docs/architecture/inference.md adds a paragraph (head lines 1369-1381) on Qwen inline-assistant MTP. It covers chained ordinary decode history, hidden-row carry, a per-drafter opt-in (`supportsOrdinaryDecodeHistory`), and rollback env switches `DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED` and `DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY`. That range is only visible in the patch excerpt, not in a numbered unit; the numbered units cover later head lines 1641-2218, where I found no changes. docs/provider/cli-reference.md adds benchmark flags `--runtime-concurrency` and `--runtime-stagger` to `RuntimeGenerationBenchmark` and `RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark`. Nothing in the supplied text changes code, protocol or deployment.

The documented behavior touches A-001 and TB-007 in that it keeps hidden-state carry and assistant history in provider process memory. This is consistent with the existing T-028 and T-014 exposure and adds no persistence. The documented MTP history is not described as touching the SSD prefix cache, so T-041's at-rest posture is unchanged. The benchmark modes are described as JSON output with prefix cache off. They are local CLI tooling and do not cross TB-002 or the App Attest boundary TB-011.

I saw no source code, so the unverified contracts are: (1) that the chained hidden-row/carry history is request-scoped and cleared on retirement, so it is not shared across cross-tenant requests; (2) that the new benchmark JSON output contains no prompt content beyond what the operator supplies. The doc assertions are plausible and no concrete regression is evidenced. A later pass should check `EngineLoopV2+MTPOrdinaryHistory.swift` once the code is supplied.
